papers.title: Airman's letter
lines: The Voyager carried us half the night. We landed where the sun was in the wrong place.
The padre says to write home. The padre has no idea what to put in a letter.

papers.title: Mess menu
lines: Monday: stew. Tuesday: stew with a hat on. Wednesday: stew, surprised.
Thursday: curry. Friday: fish. Saturday: lunch cancelled by ancient decree.

papers.title: Control tower log
lines: The geese were on the runway again. We offered them a lift and they declined.

papers.title: Airbridge ticket
lines: Seat 12C, middle of the aircraft, next to a man who has packed an entire kitchen.
He offers me a biscuit. It is the best biscuit of the flight, and the flight is very long.
